entries.title: A crewmate whose conversation gets too long carries on in a new one
entries.body: When a crewmate's conversation reached its model's limit, every turn failed again and the same messages were sent again each time. Now the crewmate continues once in a new conversation with its brief and its task's record. If that fails too, it stops retrying and your first mate is told the task needs action.
entries.noPicture: This changes how a failed turn recovers over time, not a view or control.
